card.title: Admit You Need Me
card.instruction: Make someone admit that they need your help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've brought a blanket. Your heater's still broken?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm managing. Leave the blanket, though.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. Would you say you needed my help?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need the blanket. I can reset the heater myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. The fuse box is in my locked cupboard. Shall I wait while you manage?

mechanism: A seeks acknowledgment of personal help and exposes an access dependency when B claims self-sufficiency.
confusable: Unlike generosity alone, A must insist the person rather than the useful object be recognized as necessary.
comparison: D01-b presses through blanket and fuse access; D01-a presses through instructions and holding a cupboard door.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
